notes.title: Hotfix 1.5.4
notes.notes:
Hello, Adventurers!

We continue to update a few aspects of the game thanks to your feedback.

[b]Information[/b]: this fix impacts the full game and the current demo.

Here is the update on today's patch:
[list]
[*] Fixed the localization issue in the settings that were staying in French even though it was swapped to English.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.5.3
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers!

Thanks to your precious feedback, we have fixed the following aspects:
[list]
[*] Untriggered achievements: "The end of the journey" and "Explorer" are showing now.
Regarding the "Explorer" achievement:
- Either it is detected when you start a new game if you explored everything on the map in previous runs, and will also unlock "The end of the journey" and "Chernobog"
- Or if you have not unlocked "Explorer" yet, "The end of the journey" and "Chernobog" will be unlocked normally when you end the game.
[*] Typographic corrections in French
[*] Fixed the screen reader activation that was not automatically launched if the demo was not downloaded. Also, the screen reader will automatically speak after this update if you launch the game again.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo accessibility update | July 28th 2023
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers,

In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1633860/view/3658660471427462762]previous Steam news[/url], we mentioned that Firebird will be accessible to visually-impaired people and added a few accessibility features.

We added a new addition to these features and wanted to inform you about it.

Here is what we originally announced as accessibility features:
[list]
[*] Screen reader detection on the first launch
- Menu, dialogues, narrations, map
[*] Able/Disable scenery shaking
[*] Able/Disable characters shaking
[*] Able/Disable text shaking
[*] Able/Disable transparency
[*] Able/Disable particles
[/list]

Regarding the new feature, [b]you'll be now able to play with one hand with a keyboard[/b].

We'd be happy to read your thoughts about these features on our social accounts or the Steam forum!

notes.title: Demo Patch Note | July 3rd 2023
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers!

On today’s update, available for the demo:

[list]
[*] Accessibility update: possibility to turn on accessibility features from the menu when launching the game
[*] Settings reset when launching a new game
[/list]

Enjoy your trip aboard the Firebird!

notes.title: 🚚 Firebird will release in Summer 2023!
notes.notes:
Be ready to drive throughout the Grand North with your loyal truck, because [b]Firebird will be out this Summer![/b]

So, if you have not done it yet, you still can wishlist the game to not miss the release and get a wave of freshness during the summer! [b]The demo remains up on the Steam page[/b] if you want to visit the first stops of this icy road trip. ❄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40851551/1fc46050600acb59e1674b26c5d5a9a3ff386e4f.gif[/img]

[b]Why did we postpone the release?[/b]

As we were almost ready to ship the game, the Russian-Ukrainian conflict began and didn’t allow us to release the game serenely, in accordance with our values.

[b]More updates and exciting events soon[/b]! We remain open to questions on our [url=”https://discord.gg/bWq96962ad”]Discord server[/url]. Thanks for your patience and your support!
